no-restricted-syntax.message: This formats in the runtime's zone (the device's in the browser, UTC on Vercel) — this app's day boundary is IST everywhere. Use formatIst() from lib/dateUtils, or pass an explicit timeZone if you really mean another zone.
This formats a Date in the runtime's zone. Use formatIst() from lib/dateUtils, or pass an explicit timeZone.
An Intl.DateTimeFormat with no timeZone resolves to the runtime's zone. Use formatIst() from lib/dateUtils, or pass an explicit timeZone.

paths.name: date-fns
paths.message: date-fns' day helpers (startOfDay, eachDayOfInterval, format, parseISO) all work in the runtime's LOCAL day, which is a second definition of 'a day' competing with IST. Use lib/dateUtils (istDateStr, getIstDayRange, formatIst) and lib/logDates (shiftDateStr, lastIstDateStrs).
